You must clearly indicate which parts of your submission were generated or assisted by AI.
Include a separate "AI Usage Statement" with each submission detailing:
Which AI tools were used Specific prompts used to generate content What portions of the work are AI-generated versus your original contributions
Violations include but are not limited to: plagiarism, unauthorized collaboration, fabrication of data, and any form of cheating on assignments, projects or examinations.

Suspected violations are subject to reporting to the CSE Department and the University for investigation and may result in severe penalties, including failure of the assignment or course, suspension, or expulsion.
Describe basic AI concepts and explain how AI systems utilize data.
Identify current AI trends and analyze how AI is transforming various industries.
Use AI as a collaborative tool to enhance creativity and problem-solving skills, while developing adaptability in AI-driven environments.
Recognize ethical risks and potential concerns associated with AI systems, along with the fundamental principles of responsible AI.
Identify potential AI-related problems and propose preliminary AI solutions.
